title: Closed exceptional comparison under site comparison
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Work in the ordinary derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with comparison morphisms $
u_W:W_{\mathrm{proet}}	o W_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For $	au=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$ let $I_	au=Ri_	au^!$ be the ambient right adjoint to closed direct image $i_{	au,*}$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient, lem-exc-proetale-closed-support], with counit $\epsilon^	au$.

For every $M\in D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], $I_{\mathrm{et}}M$ is bounded below. For every bounded-below lift $e:I_{\mathrm{et}}M\xrightarrow{\sim}\iota L$ to $D^+$ on $Z$, let $\delta_{I_{\mathrm{et}}M,e}$ be the canonical direct-image comparison $
u_T^*i_{\mathrm{et},*}I_{\mathrm{et}}M\xrightarrow{\sim}i_{\mathrm{proet},*}
u_Z^*I_{\mathrm{et}}M$, obtained by transporting the named Plus mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] along the Plus/full compatibility isomorphisms. Define $\alpha_{M,e}$ as the $i_{\mathrm{proet},*}\dashv I_{\mathrm{proet}}$ transpose of $
u_T^*(\epsilon^{\mathrm{et}}_M)\circ\delta_{I_{\mathrm{et}}M,e}^{-1}$. Then
$$\alpha_{M,e}:
u_Z^*I_{\mathrm{et}}M\xrightarrow{\sim}I_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_T^*M$$
is an isomorphism, natural in $M$, and
$$\epsilon^{\mathrm{proet}}_{
u_T^*M}\circ i_{\mathrm{proet},*}(\alpha_{M,e})\circ\delta_{I_{\mathrm{et}}M,e}=
u_T^*(\epsilon^{\mathrm{et}}_M).$$

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: compare the closed-support triangles

proof.text: For boundedness, construct the sheaf-level closed right adjoint using the kernel of the open adjunction unit. Exact open restriction kills that kernel, the closed essential-image theorem identifies it with a closed pushforward, and full faithfulness yields the Hom equivalence. Derive this adjunction and use uniqueness of right adjoints to identify the chosen ambient etale right adjoint with the total right derived sheaf adjoint. The Plus/full compatibility then gives a bounded-below lift whenever M is bounded below. Bounded constructible M is bounded below by its cohomological interval.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: compare the closed-support triangles

proof.text: Exact closed pro-etale pushforward and exact open inverse image descend termwise. Their composite is zero by disjointness. Under the closed exceptional adjunction followed by the open inverse/direct-image adjunction, maps from P to I_p Rj_* Q identify with maps from j^* Ri_* P to Q. The latter source is zero. Apply this to the identity to prove I_p Rj_* Q is zero.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: compare the closed-support triangles

proof.text: For bounded-below M, open restriction has its explicit Plus lift. The canonical qcqs direct-image comparison identifies F_T Rj_et,* j_et^* M with a pro-etale open direct image, which the previous step shows is killed by I_p. Apply the exact triangulated functors F_T and I_p to the etale support triangle. Its third object is zero, so I_p F_T of the etale closed counit is invertible. The defining transpose alpha is the exceptional unit followed by I_p of delta inverse and this counit. Closed direct image is fully faithful, so its exceptional unit is invertible. Thus alpha is invertible. This avoids constructing or comparing a pro-etale support triangle.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: compare the closed-support triangles

proof.text: Combine the named Plus/full compatibility transformations and the canonical Plus mate into one natural transformation on D+. Lift any map between two bounded-below presentations by fullness of the inclusion D+ to D. Naturality of that transformation, conjugated by the presentation isomorphisms, proves naturality of the transported delta, for arbitrary choices of the two lifts.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: compare the closed-support triangles

proof.text: The adjunction inverse-transpose formula immediately gives Rp(alpha) followed by the pro-etale counit equal to delta inverse followed by the pulled-back etale counit. Cancel delta to obtain the stated normalization. For naturality, apply injectivity of the exceptional inverse-transpose bijection, use the naturality equation for delta inverse, then etale counit naturality. This proves the specified equality for arbitrary bounded-below lifts without any natural choice of representatives.
